identity.name: Ellis
identity.provenance: Original supporting character in Jasper's Steven Universe fanfiction, not an official Steven Universe character

biography.on_page: Young local reporter carrying camera and interview notes to cover a community cleanup celebration; article is eventually revised to focus on storm drains and the people who repaired them.
biography.unknown: Employment outlet, personal history, specific pronouns beyond on-page she/her, family, appearance and education are not reliably established.

personality.voice: Inquisitive, brisk question-asker whose framing can become overly personal without deliberate malice.
personality.motivations: Gather a compelling local story while learning consent and privacy boundaries.
personality.conflict: A romantic headline can unfairly simplify Jasper and Greg's chosen nonexclusive relationship.

agency: Can ask whether a person wishes to be photographed or quoted, change an article when informed, and report on volunteer labor instead of private romance.
boundary: Source-grounded original character. Do not manufacture unverified external franchise biography.
